Home.title: One project: QR menu, reservations, and SEO website.
Home.body: This architecture starts with the customer QR menu and is ready to expand into reservation management and full back-office CMS. Public pages stay SEO friendly while staff tools are isolated in admin routes.

Home.seoBlockBody1: If you are looking for tacos in Lisbon, margaritas in Lisbon, or a Mexican restaurant in Alcântara, Tláloc brings together homestyle Mexican food, cocktails, and a warm neighbourhood atmosphere in Alcântara.
Home.seoBlockBody2: Guests often find us when searching for the best tacos in Lisbon, best margaritas in Lisbon, Mexican food in Lisbon, or where to book a table in Alcântara. Our menu focuses on flavour, fresh ingredients, and a relaxed dining experience.
